title: DeepSeek outage: Chinese AI startup's near-perfect record broken by massive seven-hour global outage | Mint
summary: China's DeepSeek experienced its most significant outage, affecting the AI chatbot for over seven hours, causing performance issues and speculation about a new model launch. Competitors intensified their AI offerings during this period.
sentiment_reason: The outage and subsequent performance issues, coupled with the uncertainty surrounding a potential new model launch, have created negative sentiment due to operational disruptions and competitive pressure.
